subject: Post-demo buyflow assessment and SOC 2 timelines
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@starlighthealth.com>, procurement@starlighthealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo buyflow assessment and SOC 2 timelines

Hi Ellen / Starlight procurement team,

Thanks again for joining the demo earlier — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can qualify the path to purchase: 

Recap (from our call)
- Starlight is evaluating Redwood for in-product summarization and secure patient note embeddings.
- Procurement is generally comfortable with POs but also evaluating marketplace purchasing for speed.
- Security gate: SOC 2 Type II report + DPA are mandatory; vendor risk questionnaire may be required by your InfoSec.

Asks / next steps from your side
1) Confirm preferred commercial path: PO (standard paperflow) OR company card OR marketplace listing. If PO, please confirm whether procurement or legal will own the PO creation and the expected approver list.
2) Share any standard vendor risk questionnaire (VRM) or procurement intake form so we can prioritize.
3) Target timeline: please confirm target contract/PO date (we suggested 4–6 weeks on the call).

What we will do
- I attached a SOW template and a redacted copy of our SOC 2 Type II report for review.
- Ben will prepare a PO/invoice template and a draft SOW aligned to the integration we reviewed.
- Karthik will stand by to answer technical questions on the questionnaire (he can jump into an intake meeting).

If procurement would prefer to go via marketplace to shorten procurement lead time, we can provide marketplace pricing and a marketplace addendum — but note that marketplace contracts sometimes limit certain enterprise controls (we can detail this if helpful).

Proposed immediate milestone: please send the VRM or procurement intake by EOD Friday (11/06) if possible so we can return the completed questionnaire within 48–72 hours.

Thanks — happy to coordinate a short follow-up with procurement/legal next week.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-1284

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_template_v3.pdf; SOC2-TypeII-Redacted-2026.pdf
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@starlighthealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@starlighthealth.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo buyflow assessment and SOC 2 timelines

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear recap. Short answers below: 

1) Purchasing path: Primary preference is PO (paperflow) — procurement will issue a PO once legal signs the DPA and we receive SOC 2 evidence. Marketplace is a contingency if internal approvals stall; budget owners prefer PO for tracking.
2) VRM: attaching our standard vendor intake (see VRM_request_form.pdf). Our InfoSec will run their questionnaire on the vendor portal after we receive the SOC 2 and DPA.
3) Timeline: procurement estimates ~3–5 weeks from receipt of completed VRM + SOC 2 + DPA for a standard PO. If anything on the questionnaire flags, add 1–2 weeks.

Notes:
- Legal will want the DPA with standard redlines — please confirm if Redwood accepts Starlights standard subprocessor clause (we can send markup).
- Our procurement mailbox (procurement@starlighthealth.com) should be copied on commercial paperwork.

Attaching: VRM_request_form.pdf

Can you confirm who on your side will lead the VRM completion and an ETA? Also send the invoice/PO template so procurement can pre-seed the PO.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Director, Procurement | Starlight Health
ellen.park@starlighthealth.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo buyflow assessment and SOC 2 timelines — action items

Team — forwarding Ellen's response and the attached VRM. Action items below (owner / ETA):

- Ben: prepare PO/invoice template + draft SOW tailored to the embedding integration. Please include the legal billing contact and payment terms we normally use for PO customers. ETA: 11/09 COB.
- Marissa: be prepared to own DPA negotiation and process any redlines from Starlight legal. If they send markup to our standard DPA, can you triage with Legal? ETA: initial response 11/10.
- Karthik: lead technical responses for the VRM (I'll schedule a 30-min intake with their InfoSec if needed). ETA: deliver preliminary VRM answers 11/08.

Contingency: if procurement timeline slips beyond 6 weeks, propose we offer temporary marketplace purchase for initial pilot (Ben — please pull marketplace pricing and the differences in controls).

Ben — please also upload SOC 2 redacted to the DocSend link and confirm if we can provide any additional evidence for their InfoSec review.

Thanks — I'll coordinate the intake meeting after we have Karthik's availability.

-L

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo buyflow assessment and SOC 2 timelines — action items

Lauren — all set on my side. Items completed: 

- Uploaded redacted SOC 2 to DocSend: https://docsend.com/view/redwood-soc2-2026
- Prepared PO/invoice template: Redwood_PO-Invoice-template.xlsx (attached)
- Draft SOW tailored to Starlight pilot: Redwood_SOW_template_v3_STL.docx uploaded to the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7521).
- Marketplace pricing note: marketplace pricing is ~5% higher but reduces procurement lead time by ~2–3 weeks for most customers.

Next: I'll fill out the first pass of the VRM answers with Karthik this afternoon and send the completed PDF to Ellen and procurement@starlighthealth.com. Planning to route contract work to Legal only if Starlight redlines the DPA significantly.

Ben Carter
Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood_PO-Invoice-template.xlsx
